name: eval-pack-next
description: PRE-RELEASE of eval-pack (commands: /eval-pack-next:*) — deterministic gates, lenses, detectors, tune loop. Coexists with stable eval-pack.

pythonExecutable.title: Python executable
pythonExecutable.description: Command used to run the bundled Python scripts. Default 'python3'; on Windows set to 'python' or 'py' if python3 is not on PATH.

outputDir.title: Output directory
outputDir.description: Directory where eval packs are written, relative to project root

includeRawTranscript.title: Include raw transcript
includeRawTranscript.description: Bundle the raw machine-readable transcript.jsonl in the eval pack. Default off.

includeRenderedTranscript.title: Include rendered transcript
includeRenderedTranscript.description: Bundle the human-readable rendered transcript (transcript.html) and its link. Default on.

analysis.title: Enable Claude analysis
analysis.description: Have Claude write retrospective, friction report, and prompt quality analysis. When false, only heuristic flags are included.

ticketBaseUrl.title: Ticket base URL
ticketBaseUrl.description: Prefix used to turn a bare ticket key into a link in PR bodies, e.g. https://YOURORG.atlassian.net/browse/ — leave empty to render bare keys as plain text.
